ADVFN – UK STOCK MARKET FORUMS, QUOTES, INVESTING & TRADING TALK
 
ADVFN is the ultimate stock research and social platform for the investor who demands more than just basic data. Trusted by millions since 1999, we provide a 360-degree view of the finance stock market—from FTSE 100 blue chips to London Stock Exchange (LSE) AIM shares, the US stock market, and crypto. Whether you are a trader hunting for a new stock or an investor performing deep fundamental analysis, ADVFN puts the heartbeat of the global markets in your pocket.  
UK’S PREMIER INVESTOR COMMUNITY & DISCUSSION
Don't trade in a vacuum. Join the trader and investor forum where discussion leads to discovery:  
• Active Bulletin Boards: Participate in thousands of threads and share chat for specific stock ticker symbols and in-depth market analysis.  
• Crowdsourced Alpha: Access user-generated stock insights, technical analysis, and real time breakdowns of stock news and RNS alerts.  
• Connect & Follow: Build your profile, follow top-tier investors, and get a notification every time they share a new stock prediction or stock ideas.  
LIVE PRICES & ADVANCED STOCK CHARTS
 Stay ahead of the tape with a high-performance stock market tracker built for speed and precision:  
• Fast Real-Time Data Streaming: Get a live stock quote for the London Stock Exchange, Euronext, NYSE, NASDAQ, and global indices.  
• Interactive Stock Charts: Elevate your technical analysis with professional-grade stock charts featuring dozens of indicators to track stock value and trends.
• UK Stocks & Shares: The most comprehensive coverage of stocks and shares UK, including LSE, AIM, and PLUS markets.  
• RNS news: Stay informed with integrated RNS (Regulatory News Service) news from the UK market. Get access to official company announcements, financial reports, trading updates, and regulatory disclosures as they are released.  
LEVEL 2 MARKET DATA & ORDER BOOK
 Move beyond "Level 1" quotes with the professional market research tools used by institutional traders.  
• Real-Time Level 2: Gain an unfair edge with level 2 market data. View the full order book to see where the big buyers and sellers are waiting.  
• Market Depth: Identify "iceberg" orders and volume clusters to refine your stock analysis and entry points.  
• Live Trades Feed: Monitor every trade as it happens, including price, size, and the buy/sell ratio for any stock ticker.
